title: NIST SP 800-38G, texts-catalogue and shared-NER articles and answers cite no source the census records gone
goal: No DOC tag in kb/public cites S869, S1709 or S2111, each tag that cited only them is re-sourced to a page this host reads or retagged UNK with a dated note, and a tag that also cited a live source drops the gone one and keeps DOC only where that live source states the claim

run: import re,pathlib,sys;ids={'S869','S1709','S2111'};bad=[str(p)+':'+str(n) for p in pathlib.Path('kb/public').rglob('*.md') for n,l in enumerate(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines(),1) for t in re.findall(r'\[DOC ([^\]]+)\]',l) if ids&set(re.findall(r'S-?[a-z0-9]+',t.split(':')[0]))];print(len(bad),'DOC tags cite a gone source');print(bad[:20]);sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
